_note: Walking trails. PLACEHOLDER lines are approximate, traced by eye from the 2023 aerial and shown dotted. To add a real trail, record it with a GPS app, export GPX, then run: node scripts/gpx-to-trail.mjs <file.gpx> <id> "<Name>" . That replaces (or adds) the trail with status "gps" and the map draws it as a solid line. Coordinates are [lng, lat]. SAFETY: every trail must be checked against shot fall zones before it goes on the map.
